title: Software Engineer/Platform Engineer - Kubernetes + Golang/Python + AI (5+ Years)
description:
Meet the Team
  
  

You will be pivotal in contributing to the team responsible for designing and developing the next generation of scalable Kubernetes infrastructure with Foundational Model and GPU Platforms. This is a position for experienced engineers where you will lead the technical direction, ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of AI systems while collaborating closely with data scientists, researchers, and other engineering teams.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

You will architect scalable infrastructure, and implement standard methodologies for Infrastructure as a Code with Golang along with developing platforms which offers LLMs and GPUs as service. Your leadership will influence the adoption of modern technologies and processes while mentoring junior engineers to strengthen the team’s technical foundation. This role is perfect for someone with a deep passion for solving engineering challenges in the fast\-paced AI/ML space, with a focus on delivering high\-impact solutions at scale.
  
  

Core Responsibilities
  
  

**As a Platform Engineer with AI/ML Experience you will:**  

* Design and develop scalable Kubernetes\-based platform components, focusing on reliability, multi\-tenancy, and efficient workload orchestration.
* Build and enhance platform capabilities to support Kubernetes workloads and emerging GenAI workloads (including GPU\-based deployments), ensuring performance and cost efficiency.
* Develop backend services and platform tooling using Golang and/or Python, following strong software engineering practices.
* Contribute to AIOps initiative across platforms by collaborating with multi\-functional teams, including SREs, Software Engineers to operationalize and optimize AI workflows effectively.
* Implement and improve observability frameworks (metrics, logs, traces) to enhance platform visibility and debugging.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to improve platform consistency and operational efficiency.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability, and performance through meticulous engineering practices with operational rigor.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, contributing to round the clock support, incident response, troubleshooting, and continuous reliability improvements.
* Conduct code reviews, establish standard processes, and mentor junior engineers.
* Stay updated on the latest trends in AI/ML to influence platform enhancements.


Minimum Qualifications / Requirements
  
  

* Experience: 5\-7 years of software engineering experience
* Expertise in Golang or Python, with hands\-on experience with Kubernetes platform Along with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Assist in the design, implementation, and day\-to\-day operation of a Kubernetes platform supporting microservices architecture.
* Support and help improve the existing platform that hosts a large number of business applications.
* Help automate legacy platforms to enable infrastructure as code, increasing efficiency and consistency in platform management.
* Consistent track record in designing and deploying scalable machine learning systems in production.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows, including model monitoring and retraining.
* Proficiency in cloud platforms and orchestration tools for distributed systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills for complex, large\-scale systems.
* Experience in mentoring engineers and driving technical decision\-making.


Preferred Qualifications / Requirements
  
  

* Sophisticated understanding in Kubernetes for managing production\-grade systems and ensuring scalability.
* Sophisticated experience with Docker and orchestration of complex services.
* Expertise in Golang or Python
* Develop\& enforce secure software development lifecycle
* Experience with architecting and optimizing workflows using Kubeflow pipelines, KServe, Airflow, and MLflow.
* Ability to design and implement efficient CI/CD workflows for LLM/GPU provisioning.
* Understanding of LangChain and experience designing RAG systems.
* Knowledge of integrating and scaling vector databases for real\-world applications.
* Consistent record of designing and leading the development of distributed systems.
* Experience with implementing robust inter\-service communication patterns and solving scalability issues.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
**Data \& Integrations Team \| Navan**



Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the **Enterprise Team**, you will be a technical leader building the backbone of our corporate travel infrastructure. You will architect and develop the critical systems that allow the world's largest companies to configure, manage, and scale their travel programs—covering everything from complex policy engines and approval workflows to user lifecycle management and enterprise analytics.



This is a high\-impact engineering role where you will solve complex logic and scalability challenges. You will ensure that our platform can handle sophisticated corporate rules and seamless integrations for massive global organizations. You'll collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and architects to design and build innovative solutions that empower our customers to manage their travel spend effectively.


**What You'll Do**


* **Architect Enterprise Core Services:** Design, build, and evolve the backend microservices that power the "brain" of the corporate travel platform—specifically the engines responsible for travel policies, dynamic approval workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* **Build Data\-Driven Services:** Design and develop highly scalable APIs and data processing services that manage high volumes of data, power reporting features, and enable seamless integrations with both internal and external systems.
* **Own Systems End\-to\-End:** Take technical ownership of a problem domain, architecting, developing, and launching key backend features and microservices that have a direct impact on our users and business operations.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work cross\-functionally with various engineering, product, and business teams to deliver complex, cross\-domain features in a collaborative, global environment.
* **Drive the Technical Vision:** Partner with engineering and product leadership to define and execute the long\-term technical roadmap for our data platform. Be a subject matter expert on backend architecture, distributed systems, and data integration patterns.
* **Champion Best Practices:** Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high\-quality, scalable, and well\-tested code. Mentor other engineers on backend development and advocate for best practices in system design, API development, monitoring, and operational reliability.


**What We're Looking For**


* 4\+ years of experience in backend software development, building large\-scale distributed systems for SaaS products or consumer\-facing applications in a fast\-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in backend development using **Java and Spring Boot**, with a strong grasp of JVM fundamentals, performance tuning, and concurrency.
* Proven experience with databases (**SQL and/or NoSQL**), complex data modeling, and query optimization to handle large datasets.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, resilient applications using **microservices, distributed systems, and event\-driven architectures** on cloud platforms (**AWS** preferred).
* Demonstrates strong technical ownership and a collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a proven ability to ship production\-quality services equipped with robust testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* A passion for investigating and solving challenging problems in system scalability and data integrity, with a willingness to learn and utilize new tools and technologies.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands\-on experience.


**Bonus Points For**


* Experience with AI/ML technologies, particularly in building backend systems to support agentic AI, LLM\-based features, or autonomous workflows.
* Deep familiarity with data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis), ETL processes, and reporting systems.
* Experience with performance and scalability testing for high\-throughput services.
* Familiarity with travel industry concepts (e.g., bookings, inventory, integrations with GDS or other suppliers).
